questions.stem: A patient presented with complaints of abdominal pain, vomiting and fatty stools. On further questioning, the patient told that he was taking a drug for the past few days. A diagnosis of Biliary sludge syndrome was made. Which of the fowling is the most likely drug involved?
questions.solutionHtml:
Ceftriaxone

Ceftriaxone is an antibiotic medicine used to treat bacterial infections in your body. It is effective in infections of the brain, lungs, ear, urinary tract, skin and soft tissues, bones and joints, blood and heart. It is also used to prevent infections during surgery.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number:795-796

questions.stem: A microbiologist has reported a case of mixed infection with both Pseudomonas and Proteus and asked you to take care of further management of that case. Which of the following drug is effective in this case?
questions.solutionHtml:
Carbenicillin

Carbenicillin is a bactericidal antibiotic belonging to the carboxypenicillin subgroup of the penicillins. It was discovered by scientists at Beecham and marketed as Pyopen. It has Gram-negative coverage which includes Pseudomonas aeruginosa but limited Gram-positive coverage.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number:773

questions.stem: This drug has activity against many strains of P. aeruginosa. However, when it is used alone, resistance has emerged during the course of treatment. Which of the following drugs is being described?

questions.stem: A pregnant female presents you after being in contact with a family member who has been admitted for Meningococcal meningitis. Which of the following drug will you give for prophylaxis?
questions.solutionHtml:
Ceftriaxone

  1. Ciprofloxacin is currently usually used in a single oral dose, but it should not be prescribed during pregnancy or for anyone under 18 years of age.
  2. Ceftriaxone can be administered once intramuscularly or intravenously during pregnancy and/or in any age group. However, it has sometimes been reported that isolates have reduced sensitivity to ceftriaxone.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number:212, 213

questions.stem: A 23-year-old man was suffering from Klebsiella pneumonia. He was started on beta-lactams but was not showing any improvement later the klebsiella was found to be ESBL(extended-spectrum beta-lactamase) bacteria. Which of the given antibiotics is effective in this condition?
questions.solutionHtml:
Meropenem

Meropenem is an antibiotic that fights bacteria. It is used to treat severe infections of the skin, lungs, stomach, urinary tract, blood and brain (eg. meningitis). It works by killing the bacteria that cause these problems. However, it will not treat a viral infection.



Goodman & Gilman's: The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics, 13th Edition, Page No. 1035

questions.stem: A 32-year-old woman was hospitalized and catheterized with a Foley catheter. She developed a urinary tract infection caused by Pseudomonas aeruginosa. Which of the following is not effective in the treatment of the infection?
questions.solutionHtml:
Vancomycin

Vancomycin is not effective on Pseudomonas aeruginosa (Gram-negative) infection, as it works mainly on gram-positive bacteria

questions.stem: The patient presented with fever increased urinary frequency and urgency, and mental status changes. He has a penicillin allergy or anaphylaxis. Which of the following ?-lactams is the most appropriate choice for gram-negative coverage of this patient's urinary tract infection?
questions.solutionHtml:
Aztreonam

Aztreonam is an antibiotic used to prevent or treat a wide variety of bacterial infections. This may include infections of the urinary tract, blood, brain, ear, skin and soft tissue, abdomen, bone, windpipe and lungs.



Goodman & Gilman's: The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics, 13th Edition, Page Number: 1035
